teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions covering lists and dictionaries, with debugging among the assigned topics.
Answered student questions during office hours and graded programming exercises using an instructor-provided rubric.

teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Supported beginner programming practice sessions on lists and dictionaries and functions as a peer programming mentor.
Explained worked examples on these programming topics under a course instructor's supervision during assigned mentoring activities.

projects.title: Study-Session Scheduler
bullets: Implemented a small command-line study-session scheduler in Python using functions and collections for an individual course project.
Tested example inputs and documented the program's behaviour, using Git for the course project.
